description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the performance of three metrics—Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy—across four different SimCSE variants: Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The horizontal axis displays these four model variants in order from left to right, while the vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation," ranges from 0.2 to 0.6 on a linear scale. Each model variant is represented by a group of three vertically stacked bars: the leftmost bar in each group is light yellow and corresponds to Sentiment Accuracy, the middle bar is pink and corresponds to STS Correlation, and the rightmost bar is light blue and corresponds to Paraphrase Accuracy, as indicated by the legend. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the model variants. The shortest bars across all groups are the Sentiment Accuracy bars for Unsupervised_SimCSE, which are approximately 0.55, while the tallest bars are the Paraphrase Accuracy bars for 2-Tier SimCSE, which exceed 0.6. All bars appear to be solidly filled without any shading or outlining, and there are no annotations or error bars present.
